name: Deeds
pages: Deeds are items that are used to add $(l:parcels)Parcels$(/l) to the world. Using a Deed in an unclaimed space will place a $(l:foundation_stones)Foundation Stone$(/l). The $(l:border_buffer)Border$(/l) outline and $(l:border_buffer)Buffer$(/l) outline will be displayed with the Foundation Stone as the origin. Using the Deed again on the Foundation Stone will accept the location (if it is not overlapping) and create a new Parcel, with the Deed holder as the Owner. The Deed is then consumed.

pages.title: Crafting / Obtaining
pages.text: Deeds cannot be crafted. Deeds are meant to be used as rewards, loot, or distributed by mods (ex Custom Starting Gear) or Ops/Admin. Deeds can be generated by Commands by a Nation owner or by Ops.

pages.title: Player Deed
pages.text: Can be used anywhere, including in a Zone Parcel in a Open border Nation Parcel, or can be used to claim an abandoned Citizen Parcel in an Open border Nation.

pages.title: Citizen Deed
pages.text: Can be used in a Zone Parcel or can be used to claim an abandoned Citizen Parcel of the same Nation, or in an Open border Nation.

pages.title: Nation Deed
pages.text: Must be a top-level Parcel ie can be used anywhere that doesn't overlap another Parcel.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: There is not a deed for a Zone parcel. Zones can only be created by a Nation owner using $(l:commands)Commands$(/l) or the $(l:tools)Zone Placement Tool$(/l).
